endpoint-mirror.claim: defendant A (claim): the stream state graph is endpoint-role symmetric -- swapping the two endpoint roles (local <-> remote) maps every arrow to an arrow: reserved (local) <-> reserved (remote) (server-push reservation twins), half-closed (local) <-> half-closed (remote), with idle, open and closed fixed. The RFC writes the two reserved states and the two half-closed states as mirror bullet lists, and the RST escape says verbatim 'Either endpoint can send a RST_STREAM frame' in both reserved states.
